title: Take a side before or after reading
statement: Whether learners should commit to a position before reading and then test it, or only after reading with their marked lines in view, is unsettled.
example: Two design canvases have learners take a side before reading, while the built prototype asks for it only after reading.
detail: Successive Grade 9 design directions disagree. One canvas has the student make a call before reading and then read to test it, tracking a change of mind as strength, and the canvas the design index marks current opens with taking a side before reading. The built prototype shows the question only as something to keep in mind while reading, lets nobody pick a side yet, and asks for a side after reading, with the marked lines in view. No source compares the two orders with learners.

evidence.quote: The student commits, then reads to test it. Changing your mind is tracked as strength.
